Committee: Banking and Insurance
Sponsor: Shelnutt
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 24 as introduced may increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of Insurance by an undetermined amount for additional administrative costs associated with the regulation of reinsurers. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Shay Shelnutt, Chairperson
Banking and Insurance
